chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: Kyle Walker is one of the fastest defenders in the world. Watch how he does it! A winger dribbles at him, knocks the ball past him... and races away.

chapters.label: Don't give up
chapters.text: But Walker doesn't give up! He turns, pumps his arms, and sprints back on the inside.

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch again, from behind the goal. He gets in front of the winger, and pokes the ball away. Won it!

chapters.label: The lesson
chapters.text: If a winger gets past you, don't give up! Sprint back on the inside, then win the ball.
